text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While we were working hard at training, a 
light drizzle began to fall.
choice_data_list: Mr. C.B., let's get out soon!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ? Why? The rain feels so nice!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, today's the only day to experience 
this exact rain! It'd be such a waste not 
to run in it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I'm fine! I'm used to getting soaked in 
the rain! You can go on ahead without me."
choice_data_list: Then I'll come along with you.
I can't do any more today

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it's not going up? Even though I'm 
really fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running in wet weather carries greater 
risks than usual. As her Trainer, I can't 
simply overlook it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You know all that, yet you're not going to 
stop them?
choice_data_list: Because you want to run, don't you?
Because you want to run, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then I will devote myself entirely to 
supporting you." When I answered that, her 
eyes sparkled.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, that's it. Right now, I'm just 
itching to run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I watched over Mr. C.B. as she 
ran freely in the rain, making sure she 
wouldn't get injured.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Why? Even though my heart yearns to run.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Though ironically, that freedom is 
being restricted right now.
choice_data_list:
If you get injured, you won't have time to 
worry about that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... When you put it like that, I'm 
helpless. Alright, I surrender.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That stubbornness... is starting to look 
familiar, don't you think? I know someone 
just like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. laughed as she said that, 
bringing that day's training to an early 
close.
